metadata.name: OperaLa Composer
metadata.summary: Author operational-behaviour handoff artifacts from a guided prompt session.
metadata.description: Author and manage OperaLa operational behaviours anchored to a SoRLa contract.

tools.name: list_operala_capabilities
tools.description: List all available OperaLa capabilities and their extension metadata.

tools.name: generate_operala_answers
tools.description: Generate OperaLa capability answers from a SoRLa contract and a prompt.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"sorla_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The SoRLa contract as YAML text (the whole document, not a path). Parsed with parse_sorla_contract_from_yaml; every catalog id referenced by the answers is resolved against it."},"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"Business prompt describing the operational behaviour to author."},"capability":{"type":"string","enum":["reconciliation","bulk_ingest"],"description":"Capability to author for. Omit to have the capability classified from `prompt`; the call fails if classification is inconclusive."}},"required":["sorla_yaml","prompt"]}

tools.name: update_operala_answers
tools.description: Update existing OperaLa capability answers from a change instruction.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"sorla_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The SoRLa contract as YAML text (the whole document, not a path).
